proposal.diagnosis: The codebase contained several bugs: get_range_for_difficulty set the Hard range to (1, 50) instead of (1, 200) (KB05). check_guess converted the secret to a string and performed lexicographic comparisons with a try/except fallback (KB01), and had swapped hint messages for high and low guesses (KB02). update_score incorrectly rewarded points on certain wrong guesses and miscalculated the win score on the first attempt.
changes: Updated Hard difficulty range to (1, 200) in get_range_for_difficulty.
Removed string conversion and type fallback in check_guess to ensure proper numerical comparison.
Fixed hint message strings in check_guess so that Too High suggests going lower and Too Low suggests going higher.
Corrected update_score to never add points on wrong guesses and to award 100 points for a first-try win.
